# routeros_interface_macsec_profile (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_macsec_profile" "profile" {
  name            = "example"
  ciphers         = "aes-gcm-128"
  server_priority = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the MACsec profile.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `ciphers` (String) The cipher suite used to encrypt the MACsec traffic.
- `server_priority` (Number) Key server priority. A lower value means a higher priority; the MAC address is used as a tiebreaker when both sides use the same priority.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `default_name` (String) The default name of the profile.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/macsec/profile get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_macsec_profile.profile "*1"
```
